_note: Declarative settings for the ElevenLabs agent «scg-anna». Prompt text, first messages, analysis and tools come from elevenlabs/prompt/*, elevenlabs/analysis/* and src/contract (via scripts/gen-tools.ts). build-agent.ts is idempotent (create or PATCH by name). No secrets in this file.
name: scg-anna

agent._language_note: Default ru (the caller hears the RU greeting). A preset is pushed for EVERY listed language, the default included: the live agent still holds a stale ru preset (old greeting) that must be overwritten. Each preset: language, first_message (presets.json), max-duration and soft-timeout messages; no prompt or voice override.
